_comment: Per-role MCP surface budgets over the canonical builtin and discovery definitions (ORB-21263). role_surface_budget fails when a role's tools or approximate tokens exceed its budget. Raising a budget is a reviewed decision: say in the PR why the role needs the extra surface. The resident role needs orbit.resident.metrics to inspect read-only mandate history, and orbit.evolution.add/list/show to record and read cost events; operator and manager include the resident toolset. The read-only orbit.resident.digest adds one tool to those three roles. The read-only orbit.attention task-level feed belongs to tasks-read, shared by every role and the default surface (ORB-21168). Its filter and cursor schema requires token budget increases in all six surfaces; only operator, manager and resident need an extra tool slot. Federation (ORB-21171) adds host_unhealthy, one sentence on the federated fan-out and the reserved candidate_read input the mux checks against each destination's live schema: about 70 tokens on every surface, with no new tool. Runtime kinds (ORB-21169) name run_failed, run_stuck and claim_stale in the attention description: about 70 tokens on every surface, with no new tool; operator and manager crossed their ceilings. Manager channel (ORB-21245) adds orbit.resident.control and orbit.resident.relay to the resident toolset: two extra tools on operator, manager and resident (about 1130-1200 tokens there) and names resident_stalled in the attention description (about 120 tokens on every surface, so all six ceilings move). Measured totals are default 41/~23823, operator 85/~42812, manager 29/~14809, resident 38/~23965, agent 32/~19342 and reader 14/~7732; token ceilings round these totals up to the next hundred. ORB-21619's corrected orbit.resident.relay output description (comment and answer, not a comment id) adds about 16 tokens on the surfaces carrying it; operator and manager cross their ceilings, so theirs rise by a hundred. `orbit tool list --role <role>` reports the current size. ORB-21170 names ci_red and friction_untriaged in the attention description plus provider/proxy sentences (about 304 bytes / ~76 tokens on every surface, with no new tool); resident, agent and reader cross their ceilings, so theirs rise to 24100, 19500 and 7900 (measured resident 38/~24041, agent 32/~19418, reader 14/~7808). That update did not raise operator or manager, which the same 76 tokens also pushed over: measured operator 85/~42915 and manager 29/~14911 round up to 43000 and 15000. The increase is the ci_red and friction_untriaged attention text, which every surface carries; no tool was added (ORB-21691). ORB-21974 adds orbit.workflow.land to the dispatch toolset, which is in the default tier and served by operator and resident; manager, agent and reader do not include dispatch. That is one tool and about 280-360 tokens on default, operator and resident. Measured: default 42/~24183, operator 86/~43199, resident 39/~24352. The ceilings rise to default 24200 tokens, operator 86 tools and 43200 tokens, and resident 39 tools and 24400 tokens. The land tool is gated on the host by operator capability or a resident cycle holding the merge right, so the extra surface is the landing verb the resident merge right needs. Consolidating MCP tool families behind an `action` field (orbit_task_recover, orbit_run, orbit_workflow, orbit_auto_task, orbit_decision, orbit_codebase, orbit_friction, orbit_ui, orbit_task_artifact) shrinks every surface. Measured before: default 12/~5426, operator 41/~15467, manager 28/~9270, resident 38/~14447, agent 22/~8872, reader 13/~4340; after: default 10/~4777, operator 21/~11081, manager 24/~8804, resident 29/~12140, agent 16/~7481, reader 9/~3611. Ceilings drop to those tool counts and to token totals rounded up to the next hundred, so the consolidation cannot quietly regrow. An auto-task definition's operator grant adds one `granted_tools` parameter to the orbit_auto_task family (add and update), in the automation toolset that only the operator role serves: about 57 tokens there and no new tool. It is how an operator grants tools to every task a definition mints, and only an operator session may supply it. Measured operator 21/~11138, so its token ceiling rises to 11200; no other role changes.
